content.en: The **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, also known as the Global Goals, were adopted by all United Nations Member States in 2015 as a universal call to action. These 17 goals are integrated, recognizing that action in one area will affect outcomes in others, and that development must balance social, economic, and environmental sustainability.

definition.en: The goals apply to all nations, regardless of their development status.

definition.en: The goals are interconnected; progress in one goal often depends on progress in others.

content.en: NITI Aayog acts as the nodal agency for coordinating the implementation and monitoring of SDGs in India, including the publication of the SDG India Index.

content.en: Students often confuse the SDGs with the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs). Remember that MDGs were the predecessors and were more limited in scope.
